rule: Nightfall is a timed sight curve on the player: game-time duration (16 to 24 plus about two-thirds of the Invocations skill, rounded, times 10). Sight is a percent of normal sight given by the smoothstep 3t squared minus 2t cubed over the elapsed fraction t; sight is 0 for the first 5 turns, at least 1 after, and the effect ends early once sight reaches normal. Stealth is floored at 100 while active; a second cast is refused. Halo (backlit) gives attackers +5 to-hit on the defender, umbra gives -3 to attackers without nightvision, beams double both; backlit player stealth x2/5, umbra player stealth x3/2. Storm clouds apply rain (fiery targets only) then a coin-flip lightning part; rain leaves shallow water one time in five. Clouds spread by decay tiers (80/50/30 percent), children take half decay plus one, parents lose 8, spread rate loses about a tenth per spread, and player clouds vanish when out of line of sight.
